bio.text: Heather Smiley is the Republican nominee for Michigan's 6th Congressional District in the November 2026 election; she also won the party's nomination in 2024 and lost to Debbie Dingell in that general election.
She is a retired Ford Motor Company executive.
According to her campaign website, she retired from Ford after more than 32 years and earned bachelor's and master's degrees from Central Michigan University.

sources.title: Debbie Dingell and Heather Smiley win parties' primary nominations in Michigan's 6th Congressional District
